adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog.tsx` the `onError` handler builds `message` via a template literal: `const message = `${err.data?.code}: ${t(err.message)}`;`. Template literals always return a non-empty string (e.g., `"undefined: ..."`), so `message || t("unable_to_add_guests")` will never use the fallback. This can lead to incorrect/ugly error toasts instead of the intended generic message.
